title: Minimum Cost to Make Red Nodes Connected
statement: The task is to flip node colors in a tree rooted at 0 with n up to 10^5 so the red nodes form one connected component (or none), where flipping a node costs its subtree size, at minimum total cost. Measured from turning every red node blue, it reduces to a minimum-weight connected subtree with weight +size for blue and -size for red nodes, solved by a tree DP.
